package.name: urml_flexbe_states
package.description: FlexBE states for URML — ExecuteUrmlState dispatches a validated URML program (or a natural-language sentence) through the ExecuteURML ROS 2 action, surfacing URML's validate-before-actuate verdict to the operator-in-the-loop engine. Part of the URML FlexBE worked example (RFC-0474).
